workflow.name: ChronicleAI Paid Onchain Watch
workflow.description: Free-tier Marketplace workflow: send the Watch request through ChronicleAI's Telegram bridge. ChronicleAI derives the campaign window and spec hash, executes the existing createSponsoredWatch workflow on Ethereum Sepolia, and monitors the campaign asynchronously. Payment is handled by KeeperHub Marketplace on Base Mainnet.
workflow.marketplaceDescription: Start a paid ChronicleAI Watch campaign. The first time, open @chronicleai_bot, send /start, and paste the persistent Watch token returned by the bot. ChronicleAI remembers the Telegram chat until you send /disconnect. KeeperHub handles payment on Base Mainnet; ChronicleAI creates the Watch audit record on Ethereum Sepolia and monitors it asynchronously. The workflow accepts only the six Watch request fields; request id, timestamps, and spec hash are generated internally.

targetContract.description: Ethereum contract or wallet address to watch.

focusKey.description: Use none, transfers, swaps, liquidations, deposits, stablecoin, or cex.

durationHours.description: Campaign duration in hours, from 1 to 2160.

telegramBindingCode.description: Persistent Watch token from @chronicleai_bot after the first /start; reuse it for future campaigns until /disconnect.
